<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece_pos(L):
    cont={(r,c) for r in range(34,44) for c in range(27,37)}
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(9,63) for c in range(18,64) if L[r][c]!='B' and (r,c) not in cont]
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
EXP={'bottom-left':(40,56,18,30),'left':(32,45,18,25),'top-left':(21,37,18,30),'top':(24,32,25,38)}
seq=[('LEFT','bottom-left'),('UP','left'),('UP','top-left'),('RIGHT','top')]
ok=True
for mv,name in seq:
    action([mv])
    L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    p=piece_pos(L)
    good = (p==EXP[name])
    print(mv,'->',p,'expect',EXP[name],'OK' if good else 'MISMATCH')
    if not good: ok=False; break
print('roll ok:',ok)
if ok:
    action(['SPACE'])
    L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    # report container row colors
    rows=[]
    for r in range(34,44):
        row=''.join(L[r][c] for c in range(27,37))
        rows.append(row)
    print('container rows 34-43:')
    for i,row in enumerate(rows): print(34+i,row)
    print('done?',last_action_result.get('done'),'level_completed?',last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def piece_pos(L):
    cont={(r,c) for r in range(34,44) for c in range(27,37)}
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(9,63) for c in range(18,64) if L[r][c]!='B' and (r,c) not in cont]
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
EXP={'bottom-left':(40,56,18,30),'left':(32,45,18,25),'top-left':(21,37,18,30),'top':(24,32,25,38)}
